lakehouse_tables: PRIMARY source for every ordinary seed/static question, including payment/category rankings and residence-versus-recipient comparisons. Complete static facts, registered counts, donation/gift/catalog identities and stored metric keys. Get complete data here even when relationships are also requested; Ontology supplies declarations. Also query agent_relationship_dictionary for exact source-declared arrows and agent_prefecture_category_metric for existing metric keys plus both declared edges; do not infer relation direction from foreign-key layout. Also the explicitly selected source for quality-processing requests: unique Ready control generation/run, actual raw/accepted/quarantine table counts, CSV file/run/alias provenance and source DQ judgments. These quality populations are separate from the ordinary static views and Eventhouse observations.
ontology: Single standard generation2 Workshop Ontology for selected static entity keys and exact declared relationship names/directions. Graph materialization, instance-query execution, time-series binding and consumer readiness require current successful native evidence. Lakehouse supplies complete attributes and exhaustive data sets. Supplier links are catalog eligibility, not fulfillment.
kusto: Raw duplicate-inclusive operational observations of the distributed August 2026 increments (UTC). A year-less 8月/August question, or one about data that flowed in, observations, events or municipality activity, means this source and the year 2026. Five-field bucket grain without donors or EventID. Recorded publication is synthetic CSV metadata, not actual ingestion or processing telemetry.
semantic_model: ONLY for explicitly requested Gold, quality-processed analytical results, Power BI or an explicitly named model measure. Do not route ordinary seed payment/category/count/amount questions here; they use Lakehouse SQL. StaticSeed/RealtimeIncrement same-column KEEPFILTERS, independently shifted periods and BLANK retain their model meaning.
